blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—National University coach Jeff Napa could have tooted his own horn after the Bulldogs’ latest win in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Yet despite NU’s 76-56 rout of the University of the East at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Saturday, Napa wasn’t completely thrilled. As someone who has had his fair share of battles against the Fighting Maroons, Napa urged his players to address their lapses. Otherwise, UP might make them pay. “At some point in the game, we became kind of content because we were leading big. We […]...
